<script>
  (function () {
    var input = document.getElementById('predictive-search-input');
    var resultsDiv = document.getElementById('predictive-search-results');

    // Open / closed is driven entirely by the body.search-open class.
    // The panel fades via CSS opacity (matching the mega-menu's 0.15s
    // ease) rather than a display toggle, so it animates in/out.
    function isOpen() {
      return document.body.classList.contains('search-open');
    }
    function openSearch() {
      document.body.classList.remove('menu-open'); // close the mobile menu if open
      document.body.classList.add('search-open');
      // Defer focus a tick so any closing animation on cart / nav can
      // settle without stealing focus back.
      setTimeout(function () { input.focus(); }, 0);
    }
    function closeSearch() {
      document.body.classList.remove('search-open');
      input.value = '';
      resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
    }
    function toggleSearchNav(force) {
      // Back-compat: callers may pass `false` to force close.
      if (force === false) { closeSearch(); return; }
      if (isOpen()) closeSearch(); else openSearch();
    }
    window.toggleSearchNav = toggleSearchNav;

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      // SEARCH button(s) in header / mobile mini-nav.
      document.querySelectorAll('.search-toggle').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (typeof closeCart === 'function') closeCart();
          openSearch();
        });
      });
      // CLOSE button in the header (swapped in via .search-open).
      document.querySelectorAll('.close-search').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          closeSearch();
        });
      });
      input.addEventListener('input', handlePredictiveSearch);
    });

    // Escape closes the panel.
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen()) closeSearch();
    });

    // ── Predictive search ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Hits Shopify's predictive search JSON endpoint (/search/suggest.json)
    // and renders rows client-side. We use the JSON endpoint (not
    // section rendering) because:
    //   - The response is human-inspectable in DevTools → debuggable.
    //   - It matches the previously-working setup for this store.
    //   - Row markup lives next to the fetch logic, no Liquid plumbing.
    //
    // resources[options][fields] expands the default field set
    // (title,product_type,variants.title,vendor) to include tags and
    // body descriptions. SLJ's catalog uses tags like "Glass" and
    // "Drinkware", plus French in product titles ("Verre"), so without
    // this a query like "glass" returns zero matches.
    var predictiveSearchController = null;

    function handlePredictiveSearch(e) {
      var q = e.target.value;
      if (!q || q.length < 2) {
        resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }
      if (predictiveSearchController) predictiveSearchController.abort();
      predictiveSearchController = new AbortController();

      var url = '/search/suggest.json?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q)
        + '&resources[type]=product'
        + '&resources[limit]=10'
        + '&resources[options][unavailable_products]=last'
        + '&resources[options][fields]=title,product_type,vendor,tag,body';

      fetch(url, { signal: predictiveSearchController.signal })
        .then(function (res) { return res.json(); })
        .then(function (data) {
          var products =
            (data && data.resources && data.resources.results &&
             data.resources.results.products) || [];
          if (products.length === 0) {
            resultsDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="search-no-results">No results found.</div>';
            return;
          }
          resultsDiv.innerHTML = renderResults(products.slice(0, 10));
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
          if (err.name === 'AbortError') return;
          console.error('Predictive search failed', err);
          resultsDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="search-no-results">Search unavailable.</div>';
        });
    }
    window.handlePredictiveSearch = handlePredictiveSearch;

    // Render the result rows. Each row: 80px (3:4) thumb + title + price.
    function renderResults(products) {
      return '<div class="search-results-list">'
        + products.map(renderRow).join('')
        + '</div>';
    }
    function renderRow(p) {
      var imgUrl = p.featured_image && p.featured_image.url;
      var imgHtml = imgUrl
        ? '<img src="' + thumbUrl(imgUrl, 240, 320) + '"'
          + ' srcset="'
          + thumbUrl(imgUrl, 80, 107) + ' 80w, '
          + thumbUrl(imgUrl, 160, 213) + ' 160w, '
          + thumbUrl(imgUrl, 240, 320) + ' 240w"'
          + ' sizes="80px" width="80" height="107" loading="lazy"'
          + ' alt="' + escape(p.title) + '">'
        : '';
      return '<a class="search-result-row" href="' + escape(p.url) + '">'
        + '<div class="search-result-image">' + imgHtml + '</div>'
        + '<div class="search-result-text">'
        + '<div class="search-result-title">' + escape(p.title) + '</div>'
        + '<div class="search-result-price">$' + escape(p.price) + '</div>'
        + '</div>'
        + '</a>';
    }

    // Shopify CDN image transform: inject _<w>x<h>_crop_center before
    // the file extension. Operates on the master URL returned by the
    // predictive search JSON (product.featured_image.url).
    var IMG_EXT_RE = /(\.[a-z]+)(\?.*)?$/i;
    function thumbUrl(url, w, h) {
      return url.replace(IMG_EXT_RE, '_' + w + 'x' + h + '_crop_center$1$2');
    }

    // One escaper used for both text + attribute contexts — the entity
    // set is the same for both, so there's no point in a separate
    // escapeAttr.
    var HTML_ESCAPE = { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' };
    function escape(s) {
      return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
        return HTML_ESCAPE[c];
      });
    }
  })();
